title: Elevated errors on Claude Opus 5
summary: Anthropic reports elevated error rates affecting Claude Opus 5, one of their flagship AI language models, indicating a service degradation or outage affecting users of this specific model tier.
problem_solved: This is an incident report documenting service degradation rather than a solution; it informs users about ongoing elevated error rates on Claude Opus 5.
why_valuable: Provides transparency and awareness for developers and businesses relying on Claude Opus 5, allowing them to monitor service status and plan accordingly during the incident.
